Stu Cowan reports that Kapanen fills in on the first line today #GoHabsGo

Canadiens forward lines unchanged at practice today, with Oliver Kapanen taking Juraj Slafkovský's spot on the top line. Slafkovský is undergoing treatment (presumably for the collision in Washington). That doesn't necessarily bode well for Kapanen's chances to make his season debut tomorrow.
